content:
sarah (partnerships): Heads up — we closed an ISV marketplace partnership with SparrowPay. They'll ship a Redwood Private offering via GCP Marketplace and we’ll publish a short case study after launch. 🎉

mike (sales): Huge win. Contract signed: 12mo dedicated + Private deployment. ACV ~$420k, start of quarter one delivery.

rachel (marketing): Love this — will draft the case study outline and a press/email banner. Need a two-sentence customer quote and the SparrowPay logo.

jordan (eng): Congrats! What’s the technical timeline? Any special compliance or infra asks we should scope now?

sarah (partnerships): Onboarding kickoff next Tue. SparrowPay requires PCI scope and KMS integration. They want the Private VPC deployment with audit logs. Eng checklist and notes in GH PR #6123.

olivia (product): Adding a short-list of product asks to the sprint: token-level logging toggle + audit hooks for compliance review. Rough ETA: 3 weeks for the minimal hook.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New ticket created: MP-1987 — GCP Marketplace listing (staging). Linked to PR #6123 and infra task INF-441.

mike (sales): @rachel I’ll intro you to their CPO for a customer quote and permission to use the logo. Also looping legal for the marketplace listing.

rachel (marketing): Draft going into #marketing-drafts and I'll ping legal for logo approval. ETA: EOD Thu for first pass.

sarah (partnerships): Kickoff invite sent to SparrowPay and internal ops. Also can we get a quick console banner: "SparrowPay — Live on Redwood Private" for the Marketplace spotlight?

olivia (product): I’ll mock a console banner and a short blurb. @mike can you drop brand assets in the shared drive?

sarah (partnerships): Shared assets here: https://drive.internal/redwood/partnerships/sparrowpay-assets (folder contains logo, brand kit, short bio).

mike (sales): Awesome. Thanks everyone — let’s try to have the case study + marketplace listing ready for the next partner newsletter. Team lunch to celebrate after kickoff? :tada:
